name: com.appliedrec.verid.core2.sharing.VerIDFileProvider
description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID 2 identity-checking SDK registers this Provider to expose selected SDK files through app-scoped links. The SDK can use it when a face-session flow needs to pass a file to the host app.
disableEffect: Ver-ID 2 flows that need to provide SDK files may fail to return them.
